status: PREDECLARED before any run, 2026-10-08, author w2:pC; per w2:p6 lot S-L5b. SMOKE_ONLY_NO_CLAIM: plumbing, sign and scale checks, and CPU cost on synthetic pages; no OCR or performance claim.
supersedes: config/stage_s_smoke.json (v1 kept unchanged; its S-L5 reports are kept)

findings.scale: median band height after scaling = 32 px on all 15 pages (scale is correct)
findings.line_length: median baseline arc length after scaling is 600 to 660 px, so a 512 tile cannot hold a median line

split.note: eval pages are smoke-only; the sealed volet 2 is not opened

scale.height_definition: median over the page's lines of normal_negative_px + normal_positive_px
scale.resampling: PIL bilinear on the image; baselines and distances multiplied by the same factor; nothing written to disk

tiles.size_choice_basis: diagnostic: 768 gives 4.81 entirely-inside lines per tile on average, against 0.30 for 512
tiles.line_centered_windows_basis: diagnostic: fewer than 3 entirely-inside lines per 512 tile on average, so the option is switched on; it also covers the 85 of 300 768-tiles with zero entirely-inside lines
tiles.line_centered_windows_rule: draw a readable line of the page; centre a 768 window on its midpoint, clipped to the page; keep the window only if the line is entirely inside it, else redraw (up to 10 tries, then fall back to a random window)
tiles.train_sampling: one random page of the train split per step, one tile per step

targets.detection: every line intersecting the tile; baseline segments clipped to the tile box before rasterisation; stride 4
targets.geometry_and_ctc: only lines entirely inside the tile

ctc_lines_selection: readable lines with non-empty text, drawn at random among lines entirely inside the tile

input_perturbation.description: GT baseline shifted rigidly along the chord normal by d ~ N(0, (0.5 h)^2), h = GT band height
input_perturbation.sign_check: tests/test_stage_s_sign.py: delta = -d cancels the shift, delta = +d doubles the curve error; passed, no sign change made

losses.L_det: BCE on baseline map (stride 4) over the cells of the tile, with pos_weight = min(50, #neg/#pos), plus L1 on neg and pos over baseline-mask cells; targets from every intersecting line
losses.L_geo: curve_geometry_loss between refined baseline and GT baseline (K=8 points), normalised by GT height, mean over the entirely-inside lines used
losses.L_ctc: sum of included expected CTC losses divided by the number of included lines; exclusions counted by status; entirely-inside lines only
losses.comparison_rule: report the L_geo trajectory of B3 next to B4: if L_geo rises in B3 too, the cause is not CTC drift (signal of a sign or scale defect); if it rises only in B4, that is the expected DTLR drift

evaluation.scope: full scaled page, not a tile
evaluation.before: extract_polylines on sigmoid(HeadD baseline logit), polylines with at least 2 points
evaluation.after: refine_lines applied to the extracted polylines
evaluation.cer: greedy CTC decode of the matched readable GT lines, after refinement only; levenshtein / len(gt text)

time_limit_policy: a run over the limit is stopped and reported; nothing is reduced after the fact

expectations_written_before_run.note: no expected metric values are declared; the run checks plumbing, the L_geo comparison between B3 and B4, and seconds per step
